title: PLG Activation Experiment
summary: Discussion covered PLG, Activation, Onboarding, Experiment. The team reached 2 clear decision(s) and assigned follow-up work.
decisions: Define activation as two successful workflows and ten completed runs
Test a guided checklist plus contextual templates

action_items.task: Define activation as two successful workflows and ten completed runs
Test a guided checklist plus contextual templates

transcript.speaker: Ritika Jain
transcript.text: Let's focus today's discussion on PLG, Activation, Onboarding.

transcript.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
transcript.text: The product problem is not lack of ideas. It is choosing the smallest set that creates repeat value.

transcript.speaker: Ishita Nair
transcript.text: We should design around the user outcome and remove steps that exist only because of our internal structure.

transcript.speaker: Neha Kulkarni
transcript.text: The data is strong enough to test this, but I want the success metric defined before launch.

transcript.speaker: Ritika Jain
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we define activation as two successful workflows and ten completed runs.

transcript.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we test a guided checklist plus contextual templates.

transcript.speaker: Ritika Jain
transcript.text: Okay, we are aligned on test a guided checklist plus contextual templates. Let's capture owners and move.
